responsibility: Implements AArch64-specific function ABI classification by rewriting `FnAbi` argument and return passing modes for AAPCS, Darwin PCS, and Win64 variants, including homogeneous aggregate handling, small aggregate register coercions, Darwin integer extension rules, and indirect passing of larger values.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/aarch64.rs`, this AArch64 file is for call ABI lowering: it classifies returns and arguments for AAPCS/DarwinPCS/Win64, including homogeneous aggregates and Darwin integer extension, instead of defining inline-assembly register classes, aliases, and register-usage restrictions.
